blocks.text:
To: James Garcia
Cc: Karen Harris

The reserve file arrived this morning, thank you. It opens cleanly, and the case reserves tie to the paid amounts treaty by treaty, so the incurred position reconciles to your summary line for line. That was the last file outstanding on the intake list.

That closes the data intake for the {{fact:f:E-2024-001.client}} review, with one small item to confirm rather than resolve. Two of the treaties changed retention partway through the period, and the file carries the later retention only. If you can tell us the date the change took effect, we will split the experience at the right point instead of assuming it. It holds nothing up; we can begin measuring now and apply the split once you confirm it.

From here the work is ours for a while. We will take the experience for Gonzalez, Campbell and Kelly treaty by treaty and come back to you when we have a first read on where the pricing stands. If anything on the data changes on your end in the meantime, send it and we will fold it in.
